main_text.p: In annalib. Francor. ab anno 708 ad an. 990.præstitit, palàm fit. Verba, quæ recensét C. V. Petrus Pithoeus IC. ita habent: Pro Don amur, & pro Christian poblo, & in nostra communi salvament dist di en avant in quant des savir & podir me dunant, si salvarei eo cist me-on fradre Karlo, & in adjudha, & in cadhuna cosasi cum om per dreit son fradra salvar dist ino quid il mi altre si fazet & abludher nul plaid nunquam prindrai qui meon vol cist me-on fradre Karlo in damno fit. Hic Latina lingua corrupta est ex Gallica, Italica, Hispanica, Germanica: ut harum perito prima statim fronte apparet. Aliter & congruis Latinis verbis sic reddideris: Pro Domini amore & pro populo Christiano, & nostra communi salute, ab hoc die & ultra, quantum scire & posse mihi datur, servabo ego istum meum fratrem Karolum, tum adjumento, tum alia quacunque re, sicut jure fratrem quemque suum servare decet, &c. Nulla etiam unquam litem capiam, quæ mihi vel meo isti fratri Karolo damno fit.

LIBYES. lingua utuntur inculta & barbara: qualis est & regio eorum, deserta nempe, & arenosa, carens rivis ac fontibus. Unde Libya Gr. dicta ἀπὸ τῷ λείπεσθαι τῆς ὕεως [?], pluviis destituta, propter nimiam sui siccitatem. Incolæ hujus, quia absq; legibus vivunt, & sine rationis usu, & ἄμικτοι [?] sunt, καὶ μισά- [?] [illegible, ~5 letters], dediti maximè venationibus & latro-

page.notes: Left margin note: five lines, transcribed as printed. "708" is preceded by a small mark that may be a reference sign, not transcribed. Old-French passage (Pithoeus): spelling uncertain throughout. "fit" at "palàm fit" and "damno fit" is read as printed; the final word may be "sit". "savir", "salvar", "cosasi", "dreit son" and "prindrai" are read from a small, faint type and may be misread. Greek in the Libya etymology: the letters after "τῆς" are uncertain; accents not fully legible. Greek line "μισά-" continues on the last line with a broken word, not legible enough to copy; marked illegible. The catchword "ciniis" is the start of the next page's text, as the last full line ends "latro-". No page number is printed on this page.
